[[Lord/Legends|Lord]] '''Otua Blank''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Belugan/Legends|Belugan]] who ruled the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Quarzite/Legends|Quarzite]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Blank controlled the planet with his elite guard, but was opposed by the [[Kage Warriors/Legends|Kage Warriors]].

==Biography==
Fearing that his unwilling would-be [[Kage/Legends|Kage]] bride [[Pluma Sodi/Legends|Pluma Sodi]] would be rescued by the Kage, Blank hired a team of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] led by [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] to protect a large chest carrying the bride. When [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] gave the chest to Otua Blank, his guards paid her the bounty. When Otua Blank opened the chest, however, he found a handcuffed and furious Boba Fett, and soon realized he was fooled by Ventress.<ref name="Bounty" />

==Personality and traits==
Otua Blank ruled [[Quarzite/Legends|Quarzite]] with an iron fist. Otua Blank was also very greedy as a ruler. One classic sign of this was his fat physique. Otua didn't care about anyone or anything but himself. He always wanted things done his way and punished those who refused. Otua showed tyranny when he sent his men out to kidnap [[Pluma Sodi/Legends|Pluma Sodi]]. He did not even care that Pluma never wanted to marry him in the first place and desired her merely out of lust.<ref name="Bounty" />

==Behind the scenes==
Otua Blank was voiced in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''Clone Wars'' television series]] episode "[[Bounty (episode)|Bounty]]" by [[Ben Diskin]], who also voiced [[Krismo Sodi/Legends|Krismo Sodi]] in the same episode.<ref name="Bounty" />
